da-non-sequitur.evidence: proof.md:3 γ = 1 + Σ_{i=1}^{n−1} φ_i σ_i ∈ H_n, but proof.md:19-22 'each generator term couples one further strand and lands at level n + 1' — σ_i (i ≤ n−1) adds no strand; λ-block is a two-sided ideal so supp = {λ}; proof.md:24-29 redefines 'λ − □ := (λ_1, λ_2 + 1)' (a box addition); two-row only vs general λ
da-non-sequitur.notes: Genuine side-by-side review (statement / narrative proof / Lean), main b2b349f36; findings in issue #8025. Route: other

da-non-sequitur.evidence: Containment holds, but Step 1 says every generator term lands at level n+1; only sigma_n couples a new strand. For i<n, sigma_i beta_m stays at level n with support {lambda}, which is still inside the claimed union, so the conclusion survives with a corrected step.

After #8138 the level-n terms are handled correctly (sigma_i, i<=n-1, commute with e_lambda). Residual gap: Steps 2-3 use SU_q(2) Schur-Weyl on V_box^{(x)n}, which only sees two-row shapes, and define lambda-box as (lambda_1, lambda_2+1). The statement does not restrict lambda to two rows; for lambda with 3+ rows the branching rule adds a box to any row, so the set is larger. Either restrict the statement to two-row lambda or argue by the H_n -> H_{n+1} branching rule.

Re-graded 2026-11-17 (was warn). Steps 2-3 use SU_q(2) Schur-Weyl, which only sees two-row shapes, and define lambda-box as (lambda_1, lambda_2+1). The statement covers every lambda; for 3+ rows the branching rule adds a box to any row. The proof does not establish the statement as written. Fix: restrict to two-row lambda, or argue via H_n -> H_{n+1} branching.
Statement narrowed to two-row shapes, where the SU_q(2) Schur-Weyl step of the proof applies; steps 1-4 follow.

Full review 2026-11-21. The proof now uses the ruled four-term photon 1 + phi0 s_a + phi1 s_b + phi01 s_a s_b^{-1} (no ruling conflict) and handles the vertex term via s_b^{-1} = s_b - h. Case b <= n-1 is correct: all terms lie in H_n(q) and commute with the central idempotent e_lambda. Case b = n is correct in substance but compressed: the old Steps 2-4 (Clebsch-Gordan / Pieri) are replaced by one sentence that terms with s_n act on the module induced from V_lambda with isotypic components lambda +/- box; the needed fact (left support of y*e_lambda for y in H_{n+1} lies in {mu covering lambda}, truncated to two rows by Schur-Weyl on V^{otimes n+1}) is asserted, not argued. Gap: the statement places the photon on 'three consecutive strands of the tower' but the proof covers only b <= n; a placement with a >= n (terms at level n+2) is not treated, so the statement should restrict b <= n. No empirical premises.
